reviewer: AI (Claude) independent reviewers (blind solve + informed review), separate from the author; not a native-speaker or teacher review

set.good: The farmers grow potatoes and onions.
bad: The farmers grow potatos and onions.
The farmers grows potatoes and onions.
The farmer grow potatoes and onions.
set.rule: potato처럼 자음 + o로 끝나는 일부 명사는 -es를 붙여요. 복수 주어에는 동사 원형을 써요.

patches.why: The ordering question is not unique: 'The farmers grow onions and potatoes.' is equally correct, so set ord:false (no identity field changed).

set.exko: 나는 어제 장갑 한 쌍을 샀어요.

patches.why: ko had two glosses ('한 쌍, 한 켤레') against SPEC (one gloss) and made the correct en->ko option far longer than the distractors (9 vs 2-5 chars). Gloss and example kept consistent.

set.why: 동사가 복수형 are이므로 주어도 복수 명사 shoes가 와야 해요. a shoes는 쓸 수 없어요.

patches.why: Explanation Korean was garbled ('주어가 복수 동사 are와 함께 있으므로'); q/o/a unchanged.

set.text: My grandmother lives in a small house with a big kitchen. Every weekend, my cousins and I go there. She keeps her knives on a high shelf, and we are not allowed to touch them. Instead, we wash the dishes and set the table. Her stories about the old days are my favorite part. She says that long ago, there were no supermarkets in her village, so people made their own cheese, and the whole family helped. Grandma's soup always has potatoes and onions, and it makes our weekends warm and happy.

qs.q: What is the writer's favorite part of the weekend visit?
o: Washing the dishes in the big kitchen
Grandma's stories about the old days
Setting the table for the family lunch
Eating the soup with potatoes and onions
qs.why: 글쓴이는 할머니의 옛날이야기가 가장 좋다고 했어요.

qs.q: Why did people make their own cheese long ago?
o: There were no supermarkets in the village
Cheese was a gift from the local farmers
The whole family disliked buying bread
Cheese tasted much better when it was in soup
qs.why: 그 마을에는 슈퍼마켓이 없었기 때문이에요.

qs.q: Why can the children not touch the knives?
o: Grandma wants to keep them for herself only
The knives belong to a neighbor in the village
The children are too tired to hold anything
They could be dangerous for children
qs.why: 칼은 위험할 수 있어서 아이들에게 만지지 못하게 한다고 추측할 수 있어요.

qs.q: In the passage, “the whole family” means ___.
o: only the oldest woman in the family
just a few of the young cousins
qs.why: whole은 '전체의'라는 뜻이라서 가족 모두를 뜻해요.

patches.why: Text said children may not touch knives yet 'cut the bread' (contradiction -> changed to 'set the table'); key was the longest option in 4/4 questions, distractors lengthened.

patches.why: Key was the longest (or tied longest) option in all 4 questions; distractors lengthened/varied, answer indices unchanged.
